threshold.description: Restart increase within the window that counts as a crash loop (FR-004). Default 3.

window_seconds.description: Threshold window. Must exceed slack_seconds. Default 900 (one canary tick).

slack_seconds.description: Tolerance for tick jitter when choosing the baseline observation (research R-05). Default 120.

quiet_ticks_to_clear.description: K: consecutive no-rise ticks before a cleared entry (FR-008). Default 2.

ignore.description: Units/containers that never raise a crash-loop alert (FR-002). Exact match on UnitKey.
